import urllib.request, json, os
pat = open("/mnt/agents/output/.env").read().split("GITHUB_PAT=")[1].split()[0]
req = urllib.request.Request("https://api.github.com/repos/toxicwind/effusion-labs/actions/runs?per_page=3", headers={"Authorization": f"token {pat}"})
resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req).read().decode()
data = json.loads(resp)
for r in data.get("workflow_runs", [])[:3]:
    print(f"{r['name']} | {r['status']} | {r.get('conclusion','N/A')} | {r['head_sha'][:8]}")
